claims: As of April 17, 2026, Will Anderson Jr. and the Houston Texans agreed to a three-year, $150 million contract extension.
The contract extension makes Will Anderson Jr. the highest-paid non-quarterback in NFL history.
The contract extension includes $134 million in guaranteed money.
The contract extension includes a no-trade clause.
The contract extension keeps Will Anderson Jr. under contract with the Houston Texans through the 2030 season.
The contract extension starts after Will Anderson Jr.'s current rookie deal.
The contract extension has a total value of $150 million.
The contract extension length is 3 years.
The contract extension has an average annual value (AAV) of $50 million.
The contract extension has total guarantees of $134 million.
Will Anderson Jr.'s $50 million AAV makes him the highest-paid defensive player in NFL history.
Will Anderson Jr.'s $50 million AAV surpasses the deal given to Micah Parsons.
The Houston Texans picked up Will Anderson Jr.'s fifth-year option.
Will Anderson Jr. won the 2023 Defensive Rookie of the Year award.
Will Anderson Jr. earned multiple Pro Bowls.
Will Anderson Jr. had a 12-sack 2025 season.
The extension keeps Will Anderson Jr. in Houston for a total of five more seasons through 2030.
